086  private static String getProperties(TunableConfig config) {
087    String properties = config == null ? "{}" : config.getProperties();
088    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(properties.length() + 32);
089    sb.append(properties, 0, properties.length() - 1);
090    if (sb.length() > 1) {
091      sb.append(',');
092    }
093    if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
094      sb.append("\"robust\":true,");
095    }
096    sb.append("\"mutable\":").append(config == null || config.isMutable()).append(',');
097    sb.setCharAt(sb.length() - 1, '}');
098    return sb.toString();
099  }

101  private interface TunableEntry extends AutoCloseable {
102    void updateNetwork();
103
104    @Override
105    void close();
106  }

108  private static boolean isAlwaysGet(TunableBase tunable) {
109    TunableConfig config = tunable.getConfig();
110    return config != null && config.getPolling() == TunableConfig.Polling.ALWAYS_GET;
111  }

113  private record InitialUpdate(Runnable callback) {}
114
115  private abstract class TunableValueEntry implements TunableEntry {
116    TunableValueEntry(String path, TunableConfig config, String typeString) {
117      m_path = path;
118      if (config != null && config.getTypeString() != null) {
119        typeString = config.getTypeString();
120      }
121      if (config != null && config.isRobust()) {
122        m_publisher =
123            m_inst.getTopic(path + "/value").genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
124        m_subscriber =
125            m_inst
126                .getTopic(path + "/tune")
127                .genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
128      } else {
129        var topic = m_inst.getTopic(path);
130        m_publisher = topic.genericPublishEx(typeString, getProperties(config));
131        m_subscriber =
132            topic.genericSubscribe(typeString, PubSubOption.excludePublisher(m_publisher));
133      }
134      m_subscriberMap.put(m_subscriber.getHandle(), this);
135      if (config == null || config.isMutable()) {
136        m_listener =
137            m_poller.addListener(m_subscriber, EnumSet.of(NetworkTableEvent.Kind.VALUE_ALL));
138      } else {
139        m_listener = 0;
140      }
141      m_onChange = config == null ? null : config.getOnTune();
142      m_applyInitialValue = config != null && config.isRobust() && config.isMutable();
143    }
144
145    @Override
146    public void close() {
147      if (m_listener != 0) {
148        m_poller.removeListener(m_listener);
149      }
150      m_subscriberMap.remove(m_subscriber.getHandle());
151      m_subscriber.close();
152      m_publisher.close();
153    }
154
155    @Override
156    public abstract void updateNetwork();
157
158    protected abstract boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value);
159
160    public Runnable updateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
161      if (!doUpdateTunable(value)) {
162        return null;
163      }
164      m_forcePublish = true;
165      return m_onChange;
166    }
167
168    public InitialUpdate updateInitialTunable() {
169      if (!m_applyInitialValue) {
170        return null;
171      }
172      NetworkTableValue value = m_subscriber.get();
173      if (!value.isValid()) {
174        return null;
175      }
176      return new InitialUpdate(updateTunable(value));
177    }
178
179    protected boolean shouldPublishValue(boolean changed) {
180      boolean shouldPublish = m_forcePublish || changed;
181      m_forcePublish = false;
182      return shouldPublish;
183    }
184
185    protected void reportWarning(String msg) {
186      TunableRegistry.reportWarning("NetworkTables tunable '" + m_path + "': " + msg);
187    }
188
189    protected void reportWarning(String msg, Exception e) {
190      reportWarning(msg + ": " + e);
191    }
192
193    protected void reportNullValueRetained(String valueDescription, boolean hasPublishedValue) {
194      if (hasPublishedValue) {
195        reportWarning(
196            "null " + valueDescription + " value was not published; previous value retained");
197      }
198    }
199
200    protected final String m_path;
201    protected final GenericPublisher m_publisher;
202    protected final GenericSubscriber m_subscriber;
203    private final int m_listener;
204    private final Runnable m_onChange;
205    private final boolean m_applyInitialValue;
206    private boolean m_forcePublish;
207  }

209  private final class TunableBooleanEntry extends TunableValueEntry {
210    TunableBooleanEntry(
211        String path, TunableConfig config, BooleanSupplier getter, BooleanConsumer setter) {
212      super(path, config, "boolean");
213      m_getter = getter;
214      m_setter = setter;
215      updateNetwork();
216    }
217
218    @Override
219    public void updateNetwork() {
220      boolean value = m_getter.getAsBoolean();
221      if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || value != m_lastValue)) {
222        m_lastValue = value;
223        m_hasLastValue = true;
224        m_publisher.setBoolean(value);
225      }
226    }
227
228    @Override
229    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
230      m_setter.accept(value.getBoolean());
231      return true;
232    }
233
234    private final BooleanSupplier m_getter;
235    private final BooleanConsumer m_setter;
236    private boolean m_lastValue;
237    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
238  }

362  @FunctionalInterface
363  private interface ValuePublisher<T> {
364    void publish(GenericPublisher publisher, T value);
365  }
366
367  @FunctionalInterface
368  private interface ValueReader<T> {
369    T read(NetworkTableValue value);
370  }
371
372  private final class NullableTunableValueEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
373    NullableTunableValueEntry(
374        String path,
375        Tunable<T> tunable,
376        String typeString,
377        ValuePublisher<T> valuePublisher,
378        ValueReader<T> valueReader) {
379      super(path, tunable.getConfig(), typeString);
380      m_tunables = tunable;
381      m_valueDescription = typeString;
382      m_valuePublisher = valuePublisher;
383      m_valueReader = valueReader;
384      updateNetwork();
385    }
386
387    @Override
388    public void updateNetwork() {
389      T value = m_tunables.get();
390      if (value == null) {
391        shouldPublishValue(false);
392        reportNullValueRetained(m_valueDescription, m_hasLastValue);
393      } else if (shouldPublishValue(!m_hasLastValue || !value.equals(m_lastValue))) {
394        m_lastValue = value;
395        m_hasLastValue = true;
396        m_valuePublisher.publish(m_publisher, value);
397      }
398    }
399
400    @Override
401    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
402      m_tunables.set(m_valueReader.read(value));
403      return true;
404    }
405
406    private final Tunable<T> m_tunables;
407    private final String m_valueDescription;
408    private final ValuePublisher<T> m_valuePublisher;
409    private final ValueReader<T> m_valueReader;
410    private T m_lastValue;
411    private boolean m_hasLastValue;
412  }

415    TunableRawEntry(String path, Tunable<byte[]> tunable) {
416      super(path, tunable.getConfig(), "raw");
417      m_tunables = tunable;
418      updateNetwork();
419    }
420
421    @Override
422    public void updateNetwork() {
423      byte[] value = m_tunables.get();
424      if (value == null) {
425        shouldPublishValue(false);
426        reportNullValueRetained("raw", m_lastValue != null);
427        return;
428      }
429      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
430        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
431        m_publisher.setRaw(value, 0, value.length);
432      }
433    }
434
435    @Override
436    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
437      m_tunables.set(value.getRaw());
438      return true;
439    }
440
441    private final Tunable<byte[]> m_tunables;
442    private byte[] m_lastValue;
443  }

479      m_tunables = tunable;

481    }

484    public void updateNetwork() {
485      int[] value = m_tunables.get();
486      if (value == null) {
487        shouldPublishValue(false);
488        reportNullValueRetained("int array", m_lastValue != null);
489        return;
490      }
491      if (shouldPublishValue(!Arrays.equals(value, m_lastValue))) {
492        m_lastValue = Arrays.copyOf(value, value.length);
493        m_publisher.setIntegerArray(toLongArray(value));
494      }
495    }

497    @Override
498    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
499      m_tunables.set(fromLongArray(value.getIntegerArray()));
500      return true;
501    }
502
503    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidArrayLoops")
504    private static long[] toLongArray(int[] arr) {
505      long[] result = new long[arr.length];
506      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
507        result[i] = arr[i];
508      }
509      return result;
510    }
511
512    private static int[] fromLongArray(long[] arr) {
513      int[] result = new int[arr.length];
514      for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
515        result[i] = (int) arr[i];
516      }
517      return result;
518    }
519
520    private int[] m_lastValue;
521    private final Tunable<int[]> m_tunables;
522  }

648  private final class TunableStructEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
649    TunableStructEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStruct<T> tunable) {
650      super(path, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString());
651      m_tunables = tunable;
652      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
653      updateNetwork();
654    }
655
656    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
657    @Override
658    public void updateNetwork() {
659      T value = m_tunables.get();
660      try {
661        synchronized (m_buf) {
662          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
663            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
664            m_schemaPublished = true;
665          }
666          if (value == null) {
667            m_publisher.setRaw(new byte[0], 0, 0);
668          } else {
669            ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.write(value);
670            m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
671          }
672        }
673      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
674        reportWarning("failed to publish struct value", e);
675      }
676    }
677
678    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
679    @Override
680    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
681      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
682      if (data.length == 0) {
683        m_tunables.set(null);
684        return true;
685      }
686      if (data.length != m_buf.getStruct().getSize()) {
687        reportWarning(
688            "rejected struct tune payload with "
689                + data.length
690                + " bytes; expected "
691                + m_buf.getStruct().getSize());
692        return false;
693      }
694      T tunedValue;
695      try {
696        synchronized (m_buf) {
697          tunedValue = m_buf.read(data);
698        }
699      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
700        reportWarning("rejected struct tune payload", e);
701        return false;
702      }
703      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
704      return true;
705    }
706
707    private final Tunable.TunableStruct<T> m_tunables;
708    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
709    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
710  }
711
712  private final class TunableStructArrayEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
713    TunableStructArrayEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> tunable) {
714      super(path, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getStruct().getTypeString() + "[]");
715      m_tunables = tunable;
716      m_buf = StructBuffer.create(tunable.getStruct());
717      updateNetwork();
718    }
719
720    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
721    @Override
722    public void updateNetwork() {
723      T[] value = m_tunables.get();
724      if (value == null) {
725        if (m_hasPublishedValue) {
726          reportWarning("null struct array value was not published; previous value retained");
727        }
728        return;
729      }
730      try {
731        synchronized (m_buf) {
732          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
733            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getStruct());
734            m_schemaPublished = true;
735          }
736          ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.writeArray(value);
737          m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
738          m_hasPublishedValue = true;
739        }
740      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
741        reportWarning("failed to publish struct array value", e);
742      }
743    }
744
745    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
746    @Override
747    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
748      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
749      int size = m_buf.getStruct().getSize();
750      if (size == 0 || data.length % size != 0) {
751        reportWarning(
752            "rejected struct array tune payload with "
753                + data.length
754                + " bytes; expected a multiple of "
755                + size);
756        return false;
757      }
758      T[] tunedValue;
759      try {
760        synchronized (m_buf) {
761          tunedValue = m_buf.readArray(data);
762        }
763      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
764        reportWarning("rejected struct array tune payload", e);
765        return false;
766      }
767      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
768      return true;
769    }
770
771    private final Tunable.TunableStructArray<T> m_tunables;
772    private final StructBuffer<T> m_buf;
773    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
774    private boolean m_hasPublishedValue;
775  }
776
777  private final class TunableProtobufEntry<T> extends TunableValueEntry {
778    TunableProtobufEntry(String path, Tunable.TunableProtobuf<T> tunable) {
779      super(path, tunable.getConfig(), tunable.getProtobuf().getTypeString());
780      m_tunables = tunable;
781      m_buf = ProtobufBuffer.create(tunable.getProtobuf());
782      updateNetwork();
783    }
784
785    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
786    @Override
787    public void updateNetwork() {
788      T value = m_tunables.get();
789      if (value == null) {
790        if (m_hasPublishedValue) {
791          reportWarning("null protobuf value was not published; previous value retained");
792        }
793        return;
794      }
795      try {
796        synchronized (m_buf) {
797          if (!m_schemaPublished) {
798            m_publisher.getTopic().getInstance().addSchema(m_buf.getProto());
799            m_schemaPublished = true;
800          }
801          ByteBuffer bb = m_buf.write(value);
802          m_publisher.setRaw(bb, 0, bb.position());
803          m_hasPublishedValue = true;
804        }
805      } catch (IOException e) {
806        reportWarning("failed to publish protobuf value", e);
807      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
808        reportWarning("failed to publish protobuf value", e);
809      }
810    }
811
812    @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
813    @Override
814    public boolean doUpdateTunable(NetworkTableValue value) {
815      byte[] data = value.getRaw();
816      T tunedValue;
817      try {
818        synchronized (m_buf) {
819          tunedValue = m_buf.read(data);
820        }
821      } catch (IOException e) {
822        reportWarning("rejected protobuf tune payload", e);
823        return false;
824      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
825        reportWarning("rejected protobuf tune payload", e);
826        return false;
827      }
828      m_tunables.set(tunedValue);
829      return true;
830    }
831
832    private final Tunable.TunableProtobuf<T> m_tunables;
833    private final ProtobufBuffer<T, ?> m_buf;
834    private boolean m_schemaPublished;
835    private boolean m_hasPublishedValue;
836  }

867  /**
868   * Construct.
869   *
870   * @param inst NetworkTables instance
871   * @param prefix prefix to put in front of tunable paths in NT
872   */
873  public NetworkTablesTunableBackend(NetworkTableInstance inst, String prefix) {
874    m_inst = inst;
875    m_prefix = prefix;
876    m_poller = new NetworkTableListenerPoller(inst);
877  }
878
879  private boolean hasActiveEntry(String path) {
880    StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
881    return entry != null && !entry.closed;
882  }
883
884  private boolean hasQueuedActiveEntry(String path) {
885    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
886      Boolean pendingState = m_pendingPathStates.get(path);
887      if (pendingState != null) {
888        return pendingState;
889      }
890    }
891    return hasActiveEntry(path);
892  }
893
894  private void trackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
895    if (entry.tunable == null) {
896      m_complexEntries.add(entry);
897      return;
898    }
899
900    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
901      m_alwaysGetEntries.add(entry);
902    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
903      m_entriesByTunable.computeIfAbsent(entry.tunable, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(entry);
904      if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
905        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
906      }
907    } else {
908      m_polledEntries.add(entry);
909    }
910  }
911
912  private void untrackEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
913    m_dirtyEntries.remove(entry);
914    entry.dirtyQueued = false;
915
916    if (entry.tunable == null) {
917      m_complexEntries.remove(entry);
918      return;
919    }
920
921    if (isAlwaysGet(entry.tunable)) {
922      m_alwaysGetEntries.remove(entry);
923    } else if (entry.tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
924      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(entry.tunable);
925      if (entries != null) {
926        entries.remove(entry);
927        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
928          m_entriesByTunable.remove(entry.tunable);
929        }
930      }
931    } else {
932      m_polledEntries.remove(entry);
933    }
934  }
935
936  private void clearTrackedEntries() {
937    m_entries.clear();
938    m_entriesByTunable.clear();
939    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
940    m_alwaysGetEntries.clear();
941    m_complexEntries.clear();
942    m_polledEntries.clear();
943  }
944
945  private void enqueueDirtyEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
946    if (!entry.closed && !entry.dirtyQueued) {
947      entry.dirtyQueued = true;
948      m_dirtyEntries.add(entry);
949    }
950  }
951
952  private void closeEntry(StoredEntry entry) {
953    if (entry.closed) {
954      return;
955    }
956    entry.closed = true;
957    entry.entry.close();
958    if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
959      untrackEntry(entry);
960    }
961  }
962
963  private void eraseEntry(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
964    if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
965      m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
966      m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
967    } else {
968      eraseEntryNow(path, entry);
969    }
970  }
971
972  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
973  private void eraseEntryNow(String path, StoredEntry entry) {
974    if (m_entries.get(path) == entry) {
975      m_entries.remove(path);
976      untrackEntry(entry);
977    }
978  }
979
980  private void applyPendingMutations() {
981    try {
982      while (!m_pendingMutations.isEmpty()) {
983        List<Runnable> mutations = new ArrayList<>(m_pendingMutations);
984        m_pendingMutations.clear();
985        for (Runnable mutation : mutations) {
986          mutation.run();
987        }
988      }
989    } finally {
990      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
991    }
992  }
993
994  @Override
995  public void close() {
996    synchronized (m_entries) {
997      if (m_closed) {
998        return;
999      }
1000      m_closed = true;
1001      m_pendingMutations.clear();
1002      m_pendingPathStates.clear();
1003      for (StoredEntry entry : m_entries.values()) {
1004        closeEntry(entry);
1005      }
1006      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1007        m_pendingMutations.add(this::clearTrackedEntries);
1008      } else {
1009        clearTrackedEntries();
1010      }
1011      m_subscriberMap.clear();
1012      m_poller.close();
1013    }
1014  }
1015
1016  @Override
1017  public boolean publish(String path, TunableBase tunable) {
1018    InitialUpdate initialUpdate;
1019    synchronized (m_entries) {
1020      if (m_closed) {
1021        return false;
1022      }
1023      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1024        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1025            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1026        return false;
1027      }
1028      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1029        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1030        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publish(path, tunable));
1031        return true;
1032      }
1033      String ntPath = m_prefix + path;
1034      TunableValueEntry entry;
1035      switch (tunable) {
1036        case TunableBoolean v -> entry = new TunableBooleanEntry(ntPath, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1037        case TunableInt v -> entry = new TunableIntEntry(ntPath, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1038        case TunableLong v -> entry = new TunableLongEntry(ntPath, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1039        case TunableFloat v -> entry = new TunableFloatEntry(ntPath, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1040        case TunableDouble v -> entry = new TunableDoubleEntry(ntPath, v.getConfig(), v, v);
1041        case Tunable.TunableStruct<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1042        case Tunable.TunableStructArray<?> v -> entry = new TunableStructArrayEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1043        case Tunable.TunableProtobuf<?> v -> entry = new TunableProtobufEntry<>(ntPath, v);
1044        case Tunable<?> t -> {
1045          Class<?> cls = t.getTypeClass();
1046          if (cls == null) {
1047            TunableRegistry.reportWarning("Tunable type <null> is not supported by NetworkTables");
1048            return false;
1049          }
1050          switch (cls) {
1051            case Class<?> c when c == String.class -> {
1052              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1053              Tunable<String> tt = (Tunable<String>) t;
1054              entry =
1055                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1056                      ntPath,
1057                      tt,
1058                      "string",
1059                      GenericPublisher::setString,
1060                      NetworkTableValue::getString);
1061            }
1062            case Class<?> c when c == byte[].class -> {
1063              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1064              Tunable<byte[]> tt = (Tunable<byte[]>) t;
1065              entry = new TunableRawEntry(ntPath, tt);
1066            }
1067            case Class<?> c when c == boolean[].class -> {
1068              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1069              Tunable<boolean[]> tt = (Tunable<boolean[]>) t;
1070              entry = new TunableBooleanArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1071            }
1072            case Class<?> c when c == int[].class -> {
1073              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1074              Tunable<int[]> tt = (Tunable<int[]>) t;
1075              entry = new TunableIntArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1076            }
1077            case Class<?> c when c == long[].class -> {
1078              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1079              Tunable<long[]> tt = (Tunable<long[]>) t;
1080              entry = new TunableLongArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1081            }
1082            case Class<?> c when c == float[].class -> {
1083              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1084              Tunable<float[]> tt = (Tunable<float[]>) t;
1085              entry = new TunableFloatArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1086            }
1087            case Class<?> c when c == double[].class -> {
1088              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1089              Tunable<double[]> tt = (Tunable<double[]>) t;
1090              entry = new TunableDoubleArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1091            }
1092            case Class<?> c when c == String[].class -> {
1093              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1094              Tunable<String[]> tt = (Tunable<String[]>) t;
1095              entry = new TunableStringArrayEntry(ntPath, tt);
1096            }
1097            case Class<?> c when c == Boolean.class -> {
1098              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1099              Tunable<Boolean> tt = (Tunable<Boolean>) t;
1100              entry =
1101                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1102                      ntPath,
1103                      tt,
1104                      "boolean",
1105                      GenericPublisher::setBoolean,
1106                      NetworkTableValue::getBoolean);
1107            }
1108            case Class<?> c when c == Integer.class -> {
1109              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1110              Tunable<Integer> tt = (Tunable<Integer>) t;
1111              entry =
1112                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1113                      ntPath,
1114                      tt,
1115                      "int",
1116                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1117                      value -> (int) value.getInteger());
1118            }
1119            case Class<?> c when c == Long.class -> {
1120              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1121              Tunable<Long> tt = (Tunable<Long>) t;
1122              entry =
1123                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1124                      ntPath,
1125                      tt,
1126                      "int",
1127                      GenericPublisher::setInteger,
1128                      NetworkTableValue::getInteger);
1129            }
1130            case Class<?> c when c == Float.class -> {
1131              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1132              Tunable<Float> tt = (Tunable<Float>) t;
1133              entry =
1134                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1135                      ntPath, tt, "float", GenericPublisher::setFloat, NetworkTableValue::getFloat);
1136            }
1137            case Class<?> c when c == Double.class -> {
1138              @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1139              Tunable<Double> tt = (Tunable<Double>) t;
1140              entry =
1141                  new NullableTunableValueEntry<>(
1142                      ntPath,
1143                      tt,
1144                      "double",
1145                      GenericPublisher::setDouble,
1146                      NetworkTableValue::getDouble);
1147            }
1148            default -> {
1149              TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1150                  "Tunable type "
1151                      + t.getTypeClass().getName()
1152                      + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1153              return false;
1154            }
1155          }
1156        }
1157        default -> {
1158          TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1159              "Tunable implementation "
1160                  + tunable.getClass().getName()
1161                  + " is not supported by NetworkTables");
1162          return false;
1163        }
1164      }
1165      StoredEntry storedEntry = new StoredEntry(entry, tunable, null);
1166      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1167      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1168      initialUpdate = entry.updateInitialTunable();
1169      if (initialUpdate != null) {
1170        entry.updateNetwork();
1171      }
1172    }
1173
1174    if (initialUpdate != null && initialUpdate.callback() != null) {
1175      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(initialUpdate.callback());
1176    }
1177    return true;
1178  }
1179
1180  @Override
1181  public boolean publishComplex(String path, ComplexTunable tunable) {
1182    synchronized (m_entries) {
1183      if (m_closed) {
1184        return false;
1185      }
1186      if (hasQueuedActiveEntry(path)) {
1187        TunableRegistry.reportWarning(
1188            "NetworkTables tunable '" + m_prefix + path + "' already exists");
1189        return false;
1190      }
1191      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1192        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, true);
1193        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> publishComplex(path, tunable));
1194        return true;
1195      }
1196      StoredEntry storedEntry =
1197          new StoredEntry(new ComplexTunableEntry(m_prefix + path, tunable), null, tunable);
1198      m_entries.put(path, storedEntry);
1199      trackEntry(storedEntry);
1200    }
1201
1202    TunableRegistry.publishComplexChildren(path, tunable);
1203    return true;
1204  }
1205
1206  @Override
1207  public void remove(String path) {
1208    synchronized (m_entries) {
1209      if (m_closed) {
1210        return;
1211      }
1212      StoredEntry entry = m_entries.get(path);
1213      if (entry != null && !entry.closed) {
1214        closeEntry(entry);
1215        eraseEntry(path, entry);
1216      } else if (m_updateDepth > 0 && Boolean.TRUE.equals(m_pendingPathStates.get(path))) {
1217        m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1218        m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1219      }
1220    }
1221  }
1222
1223  @Override
1224  public List<PublishedTunable> removePrefix(String prefix) {
1225    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizePrefix(prefix);
1226    List<PublishedTunable> removed = new ArrayList<>();
1227    synchronized (m_entries) {
1228      var iterator = m_entries.entrySet().iterator();
1229      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1230        var mapEntry = iterator.next();
1231        if (!PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(mapEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1232          continue;
1233        }
1234        StoredEntry entry = mapEntry.getValue();
1235        if (entry.closed) {
1236          continue;
1237        }
1238        removed.add(new PublishedTunable(mapEntry.getKey(), entry.tunable, entry.complex));
1239        closeEntry(entry);
1240        if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1241          String path = mapEntry.getKey();
1242          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> eraseEntryNow(path, entry));
1243        } else {
1244          iterator.remove();
1245        }
1246      }
1247      if (m_updateDepth > 0) {
1248        List<String> pendingRemoves = new ArrayList<>();
1249        for (var pendingEntry : m_pendingPathStates.entrySet()) {
1250          if (pendingEntry.getValue()
1251              && PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(pendingEntry.getKey(), normalizedPrefix)) {
1252            pendingRemoves.add(pendingEntry.getKey());
1253          }
1254        }
1255        for (String path : pendingRemoves) {
1256          m_pendingPathStates.put(path, false);
1257          m_pendingMutations.add(() -> remove(path));
1258        }
1259      }
1260    }
1261    return removed;
1262  }
1263
1264  @Override
1265  public void markDirty(TunableBase tunable) {
1266    synchronized (m_entries) {
1267      if (m_closed || isAlwaysGet(tunable) || !tunable.supportsChangeNotification()) {
1268        return;
1269      }
1270      List<StoredEntry> entries = m_entriesByTunable.get(tunable);
1271      if (entries == null) {
1272        return;
1273      }
1274      for (StoredEntry entry : entries) {
1275        enqueueDirtyEntry(entry);
1276      }
1277    }
1278  }
1279
1280  private void updateComplexEntries() {
1281    try {
1282      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1283      for (StoredEntry entry : m_complexEntries) {
1284        if (!entry.closed && m_updatedComplexEntries.put(entry.complex, Boolean.TRUE) == null) {
1285          entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1286        }
1287      }
1288    } finally {
1289      m_updatedComplexEntries.clear();
1290    }
1291  }
1292
1293  private void updateAlwaysGetEntries() {
1294    for (StoredEntry entry : m_alwaysGetEntries) {
1295      if (!entry.closed) {
1296        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1297        if (entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1298          TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1299        }
1300      }
1301    }
1302  }
1303
1304  private void updatePolledEntries() {
1305    for (StoredEntry entry : m_polledEntries) {
1306      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1307        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1308        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1309      }
1310    }
1311  }
1312
1313  private void updateDirtyEntries() {
1314    for (StoredEntry entry : m_dirtyEntries) {
1315      entry.dirtyQueued = false;
1316      if (!entry.closed && entry.tunable.hasChanged()) {
1317        entry.entry.updateNetwork();
1318        TunableRegistry.resetChangedAfterUpdate(entry.tunable);
1319      }
1320    }
1321    m_dirtyEntries.clear();
1322  }
1323
1324  private void processTuneEvent(NetworkTableEvent event, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1325    if (event.valueData == null || event.valueData.value == null) {
1326      return;
1327    }
1328    TunableValueEntry entry = m_subscriberMap.get(event.valueData.subentry);
1329    if (entry == null) {
1330      return;
1331    }
1332    Runnable callback = entry.updateTunable(event.valueData.value);
1333    if (callback == null) {
1334      return;
1335    }
1336    onChangeCallbacks.add(callback);
1337  }
1338
1339  private void processTuneEvents(NetworkTableEvent[] events, List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1340    for (NetworkTableEvent event : events) {
1341      processTuneEvent(event, onChangeCallbacks);
1342    }
1343  }
1344
1345  private void scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1346    for (Runnable callback : onChangeCallbacks) {
1347      TunableRegistry.runAfterUpdate(callback);
1348    }
1349  }
1350
1351  private List<Runnable> acquireOnChangeCallbacks() {
1352    if (m_usingOnChangeCallbacks) {
1353      return new ArrayList<>();
1354    }
1355    m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = true;
1356    m_onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1357    return m_onChangeCallbacks;
1358  }
1359
1360  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
1361  private void releaseOnChangeCallbacks(List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks) {
1362    onChangeCallbacks.clear();
1363    synchronized (m_entries) {
1364      if (onChangeCallbacks == m_onChangeCallbacks) {
1365        m_usingOnChangeCallbacks = false;
1366      }
1367    }
1368  }
1369
1370  @Override
1371  public void update() {
1372    List<Runnable> onChangeCallbacks;
1373    synchronized (m_entries) {
1374      onChangeCallbacks = acquireOnChangeCallbacks();
1375    }
1376    try {
1377      synchronized (m_entries) {
1378        if (m_closed) {
1379          return;
1380        }
1381        // update tunables from network changes
1382        processTuneEvents(m_poller.readQueue(), onChangeCallbacks);
1383
1384        // update network from tunable changes
1385        // updateNetwork() can run user getters or complex update code that re-enters this backend.
1386        m_updateDepth++;
1387        try {
1388          updateComplexEntries();
1389          updateAlwaysGetEntries();
1390          updatePolledEntries();
1391          updateDirtyEntries();
1392        } finally {
1393          m_updateDepth--;
1394          if (m_updateDepth == 0) {
1395            applyPendingMutations();
1396          }
1397        }
1398      }
1399
1400      // onTune callbacks can publish or remove tunables, so run them without the backend lock held.
1401      scheduleOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1402    } finally {
1403      releaseOnChangeCallbacks(onChangeCallbacks);
1404    }
1405  }
1406}
